summary: Full backend (20 pytest cases, all pass) + frontend E2E (desktop 1920 & mobile 390) of MittwochsPizza. Closed-window logic, 403 on closed orders, admin auth (401 w/o token, wrong pw error), force_open, server-side pricing (client-sent prices ignored), order flow with name validation + QR confirmation, admin orders KPIs/kitchen summary/paid toggle/delete, pizza edit/add/hide/delete reflected on public menu, settings https validation + QR preview all work. One real UI bug: pizza cards overflow horizontally on 390px mobile (price and 'In den Korb' button cut off). All test data cleaned up and settings/prices restored.

minor.issue: Order number = count_documents(today)+1: not atomic (concurrent orders get same number) and reuses numbers after an admin deletes an order (verified: new order got #001 again after earlier orders were deleted). Use an atomic counter collection ($inc with upsert) per date.
date query param not validated (any string accepted); minor.
Prices stored as float; no upper bound / 2-decimal rounding on prices.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth=424 > 390. Cards extend to x=424, price (pizza-price-*) and 'In den Korb' button are clipped at right edge; page can be scrolled sideways (visible behind checkout dialog). Cause: 112px image + QtyStepper + Add button row cannot shrink; grid item lacks min-w-0. Fix: smaller image on mobile (e.g. h-20 w-20), add min-w-0 to article, and/or flex-wrap the stepper/button row or shorten button label on xs.

issues: Badge 'Geöffnet bis 10:30 Uhr' is hard-coded and shown also when force_open is active outside the window (misleading).
Desktop: size pills wrap ('Groß 34 / cm') onto two lines inside card – add whitespace-nowrap.
Date filter uses native browser <input type=date> (shows US format 11/24/2026) instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover.

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal overflow of PizzaCard at 390px (HIGH)
Make order numbers atomic & non-reusable (counter collection with $inc)
Show open badge text based on status (e.g. hide 'bis 10:30' when force_open outside window)
Add whitespace-nowrap to size pill labels
Optional: replace native date input in OrdersPanel with shadcn calendar
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_order: number via count_documents+1 is race-prone and duplicates after deletes

AdminPage logout is recreated each render -> useAdmin run changes identity -> panels' load effects re-run on every AdminPage render (currently only on token change, so harmless, but fragile; wrap logout in useCallback)
PizzasPanel: parseFloat of invalid price -> NaN -> null sent; backend returns 422 with pydantic msg (acceptable but message not localized)
Confirmation link builds `${paypalLink}/${total}EUR` – fine for paypal.me; QR itself is fixed link as required
